card.name: "When" before co-administered or used
card.fires_on: The word "when" (sometimes "tablets") in drug interaction statements, right where the text is about to say "used", "co-administered" or "coadministered" together with another drug.

modes.label: When before co-administration
modes.description: "When" follows a statement of an interaction effect and leads into "co-administered" or "used".
modes.example: Immunosuppressants Amlodipine may increase the systemic exposure of cyclosporine or tacrolimus<< when>> co-administered.

modes.label: Drug name then used
modes.description: A drug name or the word "tablets" or "When" begins a clause that continues with "used" or "are used" in combination.
modes.example: The risk of hypoglycemia may be increased when dapagliflozin and metformin hydrochloride extended-release<< tablets>> are used concomitantly with insulin

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "used" or "paired", as in "when used with".
card.plain: It fires on the word "when" in interaction sentences, just before "used with" or "co-administered".
